title: inventory-service error-rate SLO burn
description: Elevated latency on inventory-service (p95 917ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: A slow query on table stock_levels (missing index plus lock contention) held connections for seconds, saturating the inventory-service connection pool (max 50).
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in inventory-service logs
inventory-service p95 latency rises from ~18ms to ~917ms
inventory-service memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
database query latency and CPU elevated; slow statement and lock wait logs
resolution: Terminated the long-running queries, added the missing index and set a statement_timeout for the offending query.
